title: ⭐ Mama's Boy [V11]
status_source_term: OG File | OG File | CD Quality
description: Track 10 on the original My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy tracklist shared by Complex. Leaked months after the album released. Kanye's team released a statement stating the beat was fake, but it was played during a Q-Tip Red Bull Interview 5 years later. Madlib who likely did one of the sample chops, implied Kanye didn't want to pay him for his work and possibly wanted to take primary credit for the beat which might have been why the song was scrapped. Samples "The Velvet Swing" by Acoustic Alchemy and "The Heritage of a Black Man" by Sam Dees. Interpolates a scene from the movie Friday. Originally leaked June 13th, 2011, before the OG file would later surface in May 2025.
